app.name: Majlis
app.tagline: Majlis reference client: a terminal client over the contract.

usage.secret_argument: {option} is not accepted on the command line; the value is asked for interactively.
usage.exit_codes: Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 error · 2 usage · 3 not signed in.

option.server: Hub origin, e.g. https://hub.example (remembered at login)
option.json: Print the contract's JSON instead of text
option.strict: Validate every realtime envelope against its schema; stop at the first mismatch
option.lang: Output language: ar or en (default: MAJLIS_LANG, then LANG)
option.connection: How the device reaches the hub: lan or relay
option.no_qr: Do not draw the QR code
option.pairing_id: Pairing id printed by `majlis pair` (when CODE is not the QR JSON)
option.device_name: Name to register this computer under
option.kind: Filter by agent kind: hermes, acp, harness or builtin
option.title: Session title
option.working_dir: Working directory on the hub host
option.message: Send this message instead of reading from the terminal
option.once: Exit when the first run finishes (with --message)
option.reasoning: Show the agent's reasoning as it streams
option.approve: Answer approvals without asking: once, session, always or deny
option.timeout: Give up waiting for a run after this many seconds (0 = never)

cmd.login: Sign in to a hub and remember the token
cmd.logout: Revoke the token and forget it
cmd.pair: Start QR pairing for another device and wait for it
cmd.pair_claim: Claim a pairing from this computer (the device side)
cmd.agents_install: Install an agent's CLI on the hub (a job)
cmd.sessions_show: Show a session with its live state
cmd.chat: Chat in a session and stream the reply

arg.code: Pairing code (XXXX-XXXX) or the full QR JSON

errors.not_signed_in: Not signed in. Run `majlis login --server URL` first.
errors.server_required: No hub is configured. Pass --server URL.
errors.setup_required: The hub has no owner account yet. Set HUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD on the server and restart it.
errors.not_implemented: The hub declares {operation} in the contract but does not implement it yet [not_implemented, HTTP 501].
errors.envelope_invalid: A realtime envelope does not match its schema ({event}): {problems}
errors.pairing_id_required: Pass the QR JSON, or the code together with --pairing-id.
errors.pairing_json_invalid: That JSON is not a Majlis pairing payload.
errors.config_invalid: The config file {file} is not valid JSON.

logout.nothing: Not signed in; nothing to do.

pair.scan: Scan the QR with the Majlis app, or on the other device run:
pair.expired: The pairing expired before a device claimed it.
pair.claim_success: This computer is paired as {username} on {server}.

sessions.created: Session {id} created. Chat with: majlis chat {id}
sessions.title: Title

chat.hint: Type a message and press Enter. Ctrl+C stops the run; a second Ctrl+C exits.
chat.cancelling: Stopping the run … (Ctrl+C again to exit)
chat.resync: The hub could not replay everything; re-reading the session.
chat.waiting_run: A run is already active; waiting for it.
chat.timeout_hint: The run is still active on the hub.
